notes.text:
ISO1211 field-input schematic:
- Created iso1211_field_input.kicad_pro/.kicad_sch in /home/cua/kicad_project/ and exported KiCad iso1211_field_input.net. Step 69 confirms clean title and explicit saved status.
- Isolator:ISO1211 verified pins: 1 VCC1, 2 EN, 3 OUT, 4 GND1, 5 SUB, 6 FGND, 7 IN, 8 SENSE.
- R1 Device:R 2.5k input series; C1 Device:C 10nF SENSE to FGND; R2 Device:R 562 SENSE to IN. +3.3V joins VCC1/EN; power:GND1 on pin 4; separate local FGND return. FIELD_INPUT, OUTPUT, HEAT_SINK labels connect R1.1/U1.3/U1.5 respectively.
- Wire to a blank point then Esc can discard the final segment. OUTPUT and HEAT_SINK initially had dangling labels; rewiring to the placed label anchors removed dangling markers. Verify visible green wires reach label anchors.
- ERC had 3 undriven power inputs and 3 single-pin labelled-net reports, matching external interfaces; no warnings. No extra parts added. Connectivity checked visually against intent, not by parsing netlist.
- Export File > Export > Netlist, Export (650,774), Save (757,913), Ctrl+S. Export induces title star; final save clears it.
- Scroll zoom overshot. Home then toolbar zoom-in (221,86) restored useful scale. Avoid repeated ineffective ERC scrolling; expand/collapse list entries instead.
- Prior simple value edits and empty netlist scored 1.00; AD586 0.67, RC bandpass 0.33, several other full designs 0.00. These scores support save workflows but do not establish reference agreement for this design. Current task score unavailable.
